Categories.Category: JavaEE配置错误：缺少安全角色

BugInfo.Description:
`<auth-constraint>`中定义的`<role-name>`中缺少`<security-role>`。
**例如**：如下配置文件中指定了`role-name`但并未在`security-role`中对其进行定义 ```xml <security-constraint> <web-resource-collection> <web-resource-name>Protected Resource</web-resource-name> <url-pattern>/protected/*</url-pattern> </web-resource-collection> <auth-constraint> <role-name>user</role-name> </auth-constraint> </security-constraint> ```
BugInfo.Advice: 检查程序逻辑，增加`<security-role>`的配置。

References.Reference: 730:OWASP Top Ten 2004 Category A9 - Denial of Service
